The signals that hold a value the interface follows, the typed signals and collections, the derived signals computed from them, and the bindings that tie them to nodes and controls.
Learn: [Signals](/use/learn/interactivity/signals/), [Derived values](/use/learn/state/derived-values/), [Rebuilding the tree](/use/learn/state/rebuilding/), [How signals work](/use/in-depth/how-signals-work/).

## Main types

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`BooleanSignal`](/reference/signals/booleansignal/) | class | Signal of a `boolean`, for a state that is on or off. |
| [`ComputedSignal`](/reference/signals/computedsignal/) | class | Read-only signal whose value comes from a function of other signals, computed again only after one of them changed. |
| [`DoubleSignal`](/reference/signals/doublesignal/) | class | Signal of a `double` with arithmetic that writes its result, for positions, amounts and measures. |
| [`FloatSignal`](/reference/signals/floatsignal/) | class | Signal of a `float` with arithmetic that writes its result, for ratios, progress and sizes. |
| [`IntegerSignal`](/reference/signals/integersignal/) | class | Signal of an `int` with arithmetic that writes its result, for counters, scores and indexes. |
| [`InteractiveValue`](/reference/signals/interactivevalue/) | class | Value of a node that both the code and the user change, with its bounds, its events and its two-way binding to a signal. |
| [`ListSignal`](/reference/signals/listsignal/) | class | Signal of a list, changed through its own methods so that every change notifies the nodes and listeners that follow it. |
| [`LongSignal`](/reference/signals/longsignal/) | class | Signal of a `long` with arithmetic that writes its result, for large counts, sizes and timestamps. |
| [`MapSignal`](/reference/signals/mapsignal/) | class | Signal of a map that keeps the insertion order of its keys, changed through its own methods so that every change notifies its followers. |
| [`NodeBindings`](/reference/signals/nodebindings/) | class | Signal bindings, followed suppliers, watches and queued events of one node or one UI. |
| [`SetSignal`](/reference/signals/setsignal/) | class | Signal of a set that keeps the insertion order, changed through its own methods so that every change notifies its followers. |
| [`Signal`](/reference/signals/signal/) | class | Holds a value that nodes, derived signals and listeners follow, so the interface shows each change without rebuilding. |
| [`SignalContext`](/reference/signals/signalcontext/) | class | Per-thread state of the signal engine: batches, silence, read tracking and the queue of notifications. |
| [`SignalReplay`](/reference/signals/signalreplay/) | class | Entry point of the replay that turns a plain value passed to a setter into a signal that follows the signals its expression read. |
| [`SignalReplayBinding`](/reference/signals/signalreplaybinding/) | class | Supplier that computes again, from bytecode, the argument of one setter call after the signals it read change. |
| [`SignalReplayCall`](/reference/signals/signalreplaycall/) | class | One setter call in the code of the application: the line of the caller and the name of the setter. |
| [`SignalReplayClass`](/reference/signals/signalreplayclass/) | class | Bytecode of one class of the application, read once for the replay, with the analyses of its methods. |
| [`SignalReplayException`](/reference/signals/signalreplayexception/) | class | Reason why the replay cannot follow an expression, with the advice that the dev warning prints. |
| [`SignalReplayFailure`](/reference/signals/signalreplayfailure/) | enum | Kinds of expression that the replay cannot follow, each with its reason and its advice. |
| [`SignalReplayFrame`](/reference/signals/signalreplayframe/) | class | Interpreter that runs the instructions of one expression of the bytecode with the current values of fields and signals. |
| [`SignalReplayMatch`](/reference/signals/signalreplaymatch/) | class | Result of matching one slice of bytecode against the value a setter received and the signals read before it. |
| [`SignalReplayMethod`](/reference/signals/signalreplaymethod/) | class | Analysis of one method of the bytecode: frames, instructions, local variables and the expressions that define them. |
| [`SignalReplayParts`](/reference/signals/signalreplayparts/) | class | Text of a concatenation whose parts are known values and holes left by local variables. |
| [`SignalReplayRun`](/reference/signals/signalreplayrun/) | class | One execution of a slice of bytecode, during the match or during a replay, with the signals it reads. |
| [`SignalReplaySite`](/reference/signals/signalreplaysite/) | class | Every argument expression of one setter call on one line, analysed once and kept for the next replays. |
| [`SignalReplaySlice`](/reference/signals/signalreplayslice/) | class | Instructions of the bytecode that compute one argument of a setter call. |
| [`SignalReplayUnknown`](/reference/signals/signalreplayunknown/) | class | Value that the replay cannot compute, such as a local variable whose value it does not know. |
| [`StringSignal`](/reference/signals/stringsignal/) | class | Signal of a `String` with the text operations of `String`, which write their result. |
| [`WatchProperty`](/reference/signals/watchproperty/) | interface | Action that `Node.watch(...)` runs on its node each time the watched signal changes. |

## Supporting types

Nested types and listeners that the main types use.

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`SignalListener`](/reference/signals/signallistener/) | interface | Receives the value of a signal after each change. |
